chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 344: Li Huowang Unravels a Gold-Scheme Conspiracy in His Hallucination
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang learns he was stolen from the hospital by a petty crook hoping to exploit his powers—then immediately questions if the logic is too convenient to be real.
og_description: Li Huowang discovers his modern-world hallucination has a mundane conspiracy behind it, forcing a crisis of trust.
twitter_title: When your hallucination has a plot hole.
twitter_description: Li Huowang water-boards a gold-digging crook for the truth, then realizes he can't trust it.

lore_anchors.definition: The parasitic Black Tai Sui entity that binds to Li Huowang as his "daughter"; he can summon her between worlds.
